findings.title: V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item 5 cites `with_namespace_did(self, did: Cid) -> Self` but actual signature is `with_namespace_did(mut self, namespace_did: Option<Cid>) -> Self`
findings.evidence: V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md:484 reads: '`WriteContext::with_namespace_did(self, did: Cid) -> Self` builder.' The actual implementation at `crates/benten-graph/src/lib.rs:1031` is `pub fn with_namespace_did(mut self, namespace_did: Option<Cid>) -> Self`. The doc claims a parameter type of `Cid`; the actual parameter type is `Option<Cid>`. This is a v1-FROZEN item signature-shape drift — the freeze contract in item 5 is the v1-API-stabilization-time lock for `WriteContext` shape (lines 470-507); freezing the WRONG builder signature would either (a) lock a non-existent shape into v1 (the doc is the source of truth + would direct future Composing-phase consumers to call `.with_namespace_did(did)` which would not type-check), or (b) require a v1-breaking-change re-tense at freeze time. The signature shape gap matters semantically: passing `Option<Cid>` lets the caller invoke `.with_namespace_did(None)` to explicitly downgrade an already-namespaced context to the legacy un-namespaced keyspace (a footgun if `Cid` were the only param). The doc-claim hides this footgun. Reproducer: `grep -n 'pub fn with_namespace_did' crates/benten-graph/src/lib.rs` returns line 1031 with the `Option<Cid>` shape; `grep -n 'with_namespace_did' docs/V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md` returns the `did: Cid` shape at line 484.
findings.fix_recommendation: One-edit fix to V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md:484. Replace the claim line with: '`WriteContext::with_namespace_did(self, namespace_did: Option<Cid>) -> Self` builder (the `Option` arm lets a caller construct an un-namespaced legacy ctx by passing `None` — explicit downgrade is the intended shape).' Pair this with L5-R2-MINOR-1 + L5-R2-MINOR-2 fixes in the SAME paragraph (item 5 Verification mechanism block lines 519-526). Total LOC: ~3 lines doc-prose. Cross-check at L17 §1.A.FROZEN item 5 verifier at the G-CORE-9 FREEZE re-run — this should be caught by L17's reproducibility check; recommend an L17 cargo-public-api baseline regen at G-CORE-9 build-out wave per build-backlog row 1 to mechanize the no-drift contract.
